name: cineverse-rules-tests
description: CineVerse tests. Logic suites need only Node; the rules suite needs a JDK (the Firestore emulator is a Java process). Kept out of the repo root so the Cloudflare build never sees a package.json.

scripts.test: npm run test:logic && npm run coverage && npm run test:rules
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.json --project cineverse-rules-test --only firestore "node --test rules.test.mjs sync.test.mjs"
